search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1396814 (Pacira BioSciences, formerly Pacira Pharmaceuticals) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched the exhibits of every 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2012-04 to 2026-09.

2012Q2-2014Q3 (first to third quarters) from the 'EXPAREL' row of the MD&A net product sales table in each Form 10-Q (thousands); 2012Q4 and 2013Q4 derived as the Form 10-K full year less the 10-Q nine months; 2014Q4 onward from the 'EXPAREL' row ('EXPAREL net product sales' in the 2015Q1 release) of the net product sales table in each earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, thousands). From 2019 the releases also print a 'Total EXPAREL / bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension net product sales' line that adds bulk bupivacaine liposome sales to partners; the EXPAREL line itself is used. Where an 8-K and an 8-K/A carry the same release (2020Q2), the figures are identical and the later filing is cited.

Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 51 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing; differences (printed rounding or restated comparatives; the current-period figure is kept): 2022Q2 prior-year column 130,058 vs 2021Q2 130059.
